dict.string: Dottie needs Accessibility access to position the voice indicator at your text cursor while dictating and to read selected text.
Dottie lowers the volume of other apps' audio while you dictate or while Dottie is speaking, so you can hear it clearly.
Dottie needs access to your calendar to help you manage events and provide schedule information.
Dottie needs access to your contacts to provide personalized assistance and answer questions about your contacts.
Dottie needs location access to provide location-based services, weather information, and address lookup functionality.
Dottie needs location access to provide location-based services, weather information, and address lookup functionality.
Dottie needs microphone access to record voice for speech-to-text transcription.
Dottie needs access to your reminders to help you manage tasks and provide reminder information.
Dottie uses Screen Recording to capture system audio in Listen Mode so it can transcribe what you're hearing and research topics live.
Dottie uses speech recognition for wake word detection and voice commands.
